propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a concurrent slot (21 total needed vs 20 GitHub Free cap) by duplicating test coverage already provided by the matrix test cells
The import-linter job runs the same pytest installation and test files (test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py) with identical results to _build-and-test.yml:230, providing no unique coverage
The two optionality test files carry no pytest markers and are collected by default in all four matrix cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 plus macOS), making the single-cell dedicated job redundant
Deleting the import-linter job creates an implicit collection guard risk: future changes adding markers or moving files could silently remove optionality coverage with no build failure
The CI workflow parity checks (test_ci_workflow_parity.py and check_verify_gate_parity.py) lack visibility into _optionality.yml inner jobs and cannot detect test collection loss from deletion
